answer: Each agent joins by locking a 70-credit pearl bond in escrow and filing one referral link on a lantern-lit graph anyone can trace. Any peer may dispute a link with proof; a proven fake burns the bond, half to the challenger, and a rented sponsor's bond falls to its nadir, slashed too. First fake filing costs 50 credits, the kth 50+8(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 4,046,000 plus 70,000 locked; pool 40,000. An honest agent pays 50 once, keeps its pearl.
